newsitem.title: UK: Building stocks cheery, RMC hits new high.
newsitem.headline: Building stocks cheery, RMC hits new high.

text.p: Shares in building materials firm RMC Plc broke new ground on Monday as a generally upbeat mood washed through the sector, analysts said.
Shares in RMC and Redland Plc led the pack -- both setting new highs for the year.
RMC broke through its previous annual record at 1,183 pence and was 14-1/2 higher on the day at 1,196 by 0840 GMT. Redland set a new high at 478 pence, replacing the old 475 record.
"The sector has been moving ahead of the market for the last 10 days or so -- and this is a continuation of that mood," said one analyst at a U.S. bank in London.

But players said RMC and Redland had been catching the eye more than most as investors fears about the health of the German market in which both firms have substantial interests were beginning to wane.
"It reflects a general feeling the the worst is passed in Germany now," the analyst said.
Elsewhere in the sector, Blue Circle shares were up six pence at 391, Meyer was up 2-1/2 at 403 pence and Wolseley stock was six pence higher at 470 by 0848 GMT.
